description.value: The Burrard is a locally-owned, independent boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver, housed in a building that retains mid-century motor inn character while offering contemporary design and amenities. Its central Burrard Street location makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the city, with numerous restaurants, attractions, and the waterfront within easy reach. The hotel markets itself as a stylish, playful alternative to chain properties, appealing to travellers who want personality alongside convenience.
